description: This is a Python source file implementing a chatbot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech processing, environment configuration, and a Gemini Live LLM service, with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Gemini Live LLM API, configured with API key, system instructions, and voice ID.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a processing pipeline combining input, LLM, and output components.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a pipeline execution task with parameters and idle timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of pipeline tasks, handling signals and running asynchronously.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the speech processing pipeline with event handlers for client connection/disconnection.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes transport and starts the bot.
